title: Plant Physiology welcomes Assistant Features Editors starting in 2025 and 2026
content: Plant Physiology is pleased to announce the new Assistant Features Editors (AFEs) who are joining the editorial board in 2025 and 2026 (see figures). Plant Physiology started the AFE program 7 years ago to help disseminate discoveries published in the journal and to train the next generation of editors and reviewers. Our AFEs are promising early-career scientists. They bring their passion for science to our journal, communicating to our readers each month some of the most exciting advances in research.
